purpose: Passive behavioral network anomaly detection across multi-dimensional flow metadata.

validation_metrics.validation_note: Metrics come from synthetic data generated by the same simulator and do not predict real-world performance.
validation_metrics.metrics_disclaimer: Metrics come from synthetic data generated by the same simulator and do not predict real-world performance.

limitations: Statistical anomaly detection flags behavioral divergence, not malicious intent or confirmed attack.
False positives may arise during legitimate high-throughput operations or scheduled maintenance windows.
False negatives may occur with slow-and-low, low-entropy exfiltration mimicking normal flow rates.
The AI Engine operates as an analyst advisory layer and does not replace human verification.
